تنتحرين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِرِينَ (tantaḥirīna) /tan.ta.ħi.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# تُنْتَحَرِينَ (tuntaḥarīna) /tun.ta.ħa.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
